'''Miscellaneous Decklists''' are published constructed 60s that are not a tournament dest and not a [[Decipher deck designs|Decipher.com Deck Design]]. Championship sheets stay on their event hubs. Decipher.com general articles stay on [[Decipher deck designs]]. Fan-site catalogs stay on [[DeckTech decks]], [[Game Players Network decks]], [[Corellian Engineering Corporation decks]], and [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG decks]].

This hub indexes the rest: GEMP screenshots, personal lists, and other published 60s. Each dest keeps a [[GEMP importable decklist|GEMP Importable deck]] download. Player pages list those dests under Miscellaneous decklists.

A parent index of all published 60s is [[Decklists]].
